          definition:
          store:Store = Store.allInstance()->any(s | s.Id = storeID)
            
            precondition:
          not Store.allInstance()->excludes(store) and store.IsOpened = true
            
            postcondition:
          let storeExists:Boolean = not Store.allInstance()->excludes(store), storeOpenStatus:Boolean = store.IsOpened = true in storeExists and storeOpenStatus and self.CurrentStore = store and result = storeOpenStatus
